text:
Maria Chen: FYI EmeraldAI sent final redlines for their open-model 3.0 weights. Main asks: permission to host on cloud marketplaces, allow SI/hardware bundling, and co-branded announce. Can legal confirm redistribution scope?
Aj Patel: skimmed — their clause is very broad. Can you paste exact language?
Maria Chen: pasted below:
```
EmeraldAI grants Redwood non-exclusive, worldwide rights to host, distribute, and sublicense the Model solely for inference services via cloud marketplaces, hardware bundles, and partner SI integrations. Redistribution to third-party marketplaces must include attribution and EULA notice.
```
Devin Ross: "sublicense" worries me. Could downstream resellers claim rights to redistribute raw weights? We should limit to serving endpoints and packaged runtime only.
Aj Patel: agreed. I'll propose tightening: allow hosting/serving and distribution as a packaged service, prohibit distribution of raw model files, require attribution + EULA in UI, and explicit export compliance language.
Samir Gupta: from ops: hardware partners like GigaEdge expect a packaged runtime image, not raw weights. We must ban "download of raw weights" explicitly and add packaging/manifest requirements (container + signed artifact).
Alice Nguyen: privacy note — Emerald asked for telemetry. We need explicit opt-in and only aggregated metrics. Also KMS/HSM requirement for private deployments.
Maria Chen: EmeraldAI said aggregated metrics are OK. They want a 70/30 revenue split on marketplace hosting fees. Finance will push back on that.
Olivia (Marketing): for announcement cadence, they asked for a 1-week embargo. Product wants 2 weeks to prepare benchmarks and docs. Recommend staged announce: partner preview (private) + public release.
Devin Ross: product prefers 2 weeks public lead time. Is partner comfortable with staged timeline?
Maria Chen: will ask. Next steps I propose: Aj to send redline by EOD with tightened redistribution + export clauses; Samir to write packaging/manifest checklist for SI/hw bundles; Olivia to draft announce cadence; Alice to add telemetry/KMS language; I'll coordinate with Emerald. Everyone ok?
Aj Patel: on it. Quick Q for export controls — partner HQ in EU, but does their upstream model include restricted data? We need an explicit origin/warranties clause.
Samir Gupta: ops note — we should require a signed SBOM for model artifacts and a signature on the bundle (sha256). That covers tamper and helps marketplace listings.
Olivia (Marketing): I'll own the announce timeline doc at /shared/partners/emerald/announce.md and add messaging options (co-brand, quotes, embargo windows).
OpsBot: Created ticket INF-4391: "EmeraldAI packaging + legal review" and assigned to @Samir @Aj @Alice.
Maria Chen: thanks :thumbsup: Reconvene tomorrow 9am PT to close redlines?
Deploy-bot: Reminder set for 9:00 AM PT tomorrow.
Devin Ross: one more — can marketplace UI show a "no downloads" badge so customers understand weights aren't downloadable? Small product change.
Samir Gupta: yep, ops can add a flag to listing metadata and include the badge. I'll add to INF-4391 checklist.
Alice Nguyen: confirmed telemetry clause: aggregated metrics only, no user-level identifiers, opt-in for customers. I'll draft wording and post for review.
Maria Chen: perfect. I'll update Emerald with our counter and put the embargo ask on hold until we confirm legal + finance. Thanks all.
